about: Key 1 transaction check vectors. packages/cli-go (solana/txcheck), packages/mcp (src/solana/verify-transaction.ts)
and apps/sign (src/lib/verify-transaction.ts) must each sign every message marked sign: true and refuse every other one.
Generated by packages/cli-go with: go test ./solana/txcheck -run TestVectors -update. Do not edit by hand: that
command also rewrites the copies in packages/mcp/tests/fixtures and apps/sign/tests, which must stay identical.
message is a legacy Solana message in base64; network picks the USDC mint; amounts are USDC base units (6 decimals).
